notes.subject: Kristy call notes — final handwritten batch
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Gold Rush Days in South Pass City. The listed 307-332-3584 number is marked bad and says to find a new one; another number, 307-332-3681, is also written. Notes mention Ashley and roughly an 1,800-person event with no bounce houses. Adventure Zone has prior email outreach to South Pass City. Flag contact information for cleanup before any future outreach.
